extensionName.message: Video Timeline Marker for YouTube & Twitch

extensionDescription.message: Mark YouTube/Twitch video and stream timestamps, add notes, sync timelines with Google Drive, and export or re-import TXT timelines.

markerSavedHint.message: Marker saved. Notes are saved automatically as you type.

notePlaceholder.message: Note: Why did you save this moment?

noMarkersCurrent.message: There are no markers for this video yet.

noMarkersExport.message: There are no markers for this video to export.

twitchNoReliableTime.message: A reliable Twitch live elapsed time could not be read; the distorted HTML video timeline is disabled.

popupAddCurrentUnavailable.message: Open a supported YouTube or Twitch video first.

popupEmpty.message: No markers yet. Open a YouTube or Twitch video and click the marker button.

exportNoMarkers.message: There are no markers to export.

selectMediaForBatch.message: Select “$TITLE$” for batch export or deletion

importSummary.message: Import complete: $ADDED$ added, $UPDATED$ notes restored, $SKIPPED$ duplicates skipped, $CONFLICTS$ conflicts

importFailedAll.message: No valid timeline markers were found. Choose TXT files exported by this extension.

confirmDeleteMedia.message: Delete all $COUNT$ markers from “$TITLE$”? This cannot be undone.

confirmDeleteSelected.message: Delete $GROUPS$ selected video/stream group(s), containing $MARKERS$ markers total? This cannot be undone.

importResultWarningTitle.message: Import complete with items to review

importResultSummary.message: $FILES$ file(s), $PARSED$ marker(s) read; $ADDED$ added, $UPDATED$ notes restored, $SKIPPED$ duplicates skipped, $CONFLICTS$ conflicts, $FAILED$ file(s) failed

importFileSuccess.message: Format: $FORMAT$; $PARSED$ read, $ADDED$ added, $UPDATED$ notes restored, $SKIPPED$ duplicates, $CONFLICTS$ conflicts

importWarningMissingUrl.message: No original URL was found. Markers can be imported, but Open may not return to the video.

importWarningUnknownPlatform.message: Could not determine YouTube or Twitch. Check the Platform or Original URL field.

importWarningMissingTitle.message: No title was found. The TXT filename will be used as the media title.

importErrorNoTimestamps.message: No recognizable marker timestamps were found. Supported examples include [49:29], [1:50:20], and legacy [Estimated 49:29].

importErrorNoMarkers.message: The file was read, but no valid markers could be created.

openReuseHint.message: Open this timestamp. If the same YouTube/Twitch media is already open, that tab will be reused.

importPageDescription.message: Choose TXT files exported by Video Timeline Marker. Timestamps and notes are safely merged back into the popup data, with a clear per-file success, failure, duplicate, or conflict result.

importPageSupported.message: Supports the current format, legacy v0.1.x–v0.2.1 exports, and standalone [49:29], [1:50:20], 49:29, or 1:50:20 timestamp lines.

importErrorStorage.message: Could not write to Firefox local storage: $DETAIL$

importStorageFailureSummary.message: The files were parsed, but the data was not saved. $DETAIL$

syncSetupHelp.message: Sign in with your Google account to enable sync. The extension requests only the Google Drive app-data scope and cannot read normal Drive files.

syncSummaryConnected.message: Google Drive sync is active · $1 markers

syncSummaryDisconnected.message: Your markers stay local until Google Drive sync is connected.

syncConfirmDisconnect.message: Disconnect Google Drive sync? Local timeline markers will remain on this device.

syncErrorInvalidClientId.message: This build has an invalid Google OAuth configuration. Update the extension or contact the developer.

syncErrorNotConnected.message: Google Drive sync is not connected.

syncErrorAuthorizationExpired.message: Google authorization expired or was revoked. Connect again.

syncErrorScope.message: Google Drive app-data permission was not granted.

syncErrorRefreshToken.message: Google did not return a refresh token. Reconnect and approve access again.

syncErrorOauthState.message: The OAuth response could not be verified. Please try connecting again.

syncErrorOauthCode.message: Google did not return an authorization code. Please try again.

syncErrorAccessDenied.message: Google did not issue an authorization code. If you did not cancel, make sure the selected Google account is an OAuth test user; Workspace or supervised-account policy can also block access.

syncErrorCloudInvalid.message: The cloud sync file is not valid JSON. Local markers were not overwritten.

syncErrorSchema.message: The cloud sync file was created by an unsupported newer schema. Local markers were not overwritten.

syncErrorDrive.message: Google Drive could not be read or updated. Check that Drive API is enabled for this OAuth client.

syncErrorGeneric.message: Google Drive sync failed. Please try again.

syncErrorDataPermission.message: Firefox permission to send sync data outside the extension was not granted. Google Drive sync stays off.

syncErrorOauthLaunch.message: Firefox could not start the Google authorization flow. Check that the OAuth client is a Desktop app and try again.

syncErrorRedirectUri.message: Google rejected the OAuth redirect URI. Confirm the OAuth client type is Desktop app and reconnect.

syncErrorInvalidRequest.message: Google rejected the OAuth authorization request. Check the OAuth client configuration and try again.

syncErrorInvalidClient.message: The configured Google OAuth client is invalid or has been deleted. Please update the extension OAuth configuration.

syncErrorAccountPolicy.message: This Google account or organization policy does not allow this OAuth app.

syncErrorUserAgent.message: Google rejected the browser used for authorization. Please update Firefox and try again.

syncErrorOauthCancelled.message: Google authorization was cancelled before the callback was received.

syncErrorOauthTimeout.message: Google authorization timed out. Please try connecting again.

syncErrorOauthFallback.message: This Firefox-based browser could not complete the OAuth compatibility callback. Please update the browser and try again.

confirmAutoHint.message: Deleting in 1 second. Move your mouse over this window to pause.

confirmPausedHint.message: Auto-delete paused. Choose Delete or Keep.

hostAccessPrompt.message: Allow access to YouTube / Twitch so the marker button can appear on mobile pages.

syncLeaveNotice.message: The Google sign-in page has opened in your browser. Please close this screen (go back to the browser tabs) to finish signing in.
